div.span: enrichPage — the page, never the set
Rescue — the one enrichment paid for before pagination
Fan-out — parallel, one budget per provider
fails a filter the caller ticked

fails only the OA / full-text gate
and carries a DOI

pass 0, concurrent: Crossref · OpenAlex · Unpaywall
first to supply a field owns it in fieldSources

pass 1: OpenCitations, and only for
papers still missing a citation count

applyFacts · preferredPdfUrl rewrites hosts
that advertise a PDF they serve an interstitial for

abandoned lookups are reported,
never thrown — the page still ships

first SEARCH_RESCUE_LIMIT candidates, in rank order
default 200, independent of the page

only authorities authoritative on
fullText or oaStatus — today, Unpaywall alone
rejoins at the rank it already had

ProviderCache
provider · nativeQuery · depth · offset · normalizerVersion

translate → fetch → normalize
inside a 20s AbortController budget

status: timeout — retryable,
the abort stops it decoding on a shared thread

skipped, with the reason named
bioRxiv on a keyword query, say —
reported, not counted as a failure

mergePapers — group by identityKey
DOI, else title+year, else source ref
highest-priority record is the base;
every gap filled from the best record that has it,
attributed in fieldSources

rank
RRF over each provider's own ordering (k=60)
+ query/title/abstract overlap ×1.25
+ record quality as a tiebreak only

settled — dropped.
No authority supplies these fields.

rebuild by walking the ranked list
— substitution, not appending

generateFacets over the filtered set
with facetBaseSets: a facet is not counted
over its own selection, so a second year
can still be ticked

sortPapers again — enrichment just rewrote
title, authors, year, venue, publisher, citationCount,
which are the keys the page was ordered by
papers · total · facets · reports · authorities · rescue · complete

AuthorityCache — per-search memo of
(authority, DOI) → facts, shared with the rescue,
so a rescued paper on the visible page
is not asked about twice
